assert_is_instance_check_type: assert an object is an instance of a given class and raise TypeError if not
assert_is_instance_validate_input: validate that a function argument is the expected type before processing it
none_throws_guard_none: throw a ValueError if a value is None, otherwise return the value
none_throws_custom_error_msg: throw a ValueError with a custom message when a value is None
none_throws_unwrap_optional: unwrap an optional value and raise an error if it is None
